summary: Grown Rogue International Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into definitive agreements to acquire the New York cannabis license and assets of PharmaCann Inc. through newly formed subsidiary Grown Rogue New York, LLC (GRNY), a joint venture 51% owned by the Company and 49% by a Capital Partner. The Capital Partner invested $10 million for preferred equity, earning priority distributions ($1M year one, $2M thereafter), with optional conversion into subordinate voting shares at $0.55–$0.76, implying ~18.2 million shares (~7% dilution). No price per share or premium stated. Pending regulatory approvals; watch for definitive acquisition terms and conversion/exit mechanics.
